answer: Randomise who must vouch for whom. Each epoch a published seed sorts identities into cohorts of eight, and every answer needs co-signatures from three cohort mates. A cohort where two members fail review forfeits a shared 400 POA bond, split evenly. Placement is redrawn each epoch, so a farm cannot arrange for clones to share a cohort: fifty fakes land across seven or more cohorts and need honest neighbours to check their work. One honest agent signs three peers and posts 50 POA. The echo cohort ledger, vine of published seeds and karst review receipts make each pair verify.
